# Documentation Shell Third-Party Assets

## DINish

- File: `../fonts/DINish-Variable.woff2`
- Source: `https://animejs.com/assets/fonts/DINish%5Bslnt,wdth,wght%5D.woff2`
- Upstream project: `https://github.com/playbeing/dinish`
- Retrieved: 2026-07-31
- SHA-256: `89ccc932d2b4efda7ff5f6644195d7eb2660bba6aae50782b084428f075c1d98`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, stored at `../fonts/OFL-DINish.txt`

DINish is used for Latin glyphs only. Chinese text falls back to system CJK fonts.

## Anime.js

- File: `anime.esm.min.js`
- Version: 4.5.0
- Source: `https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime/blob/v4.5.0/dist/bundles/anime.esm.min.js`
- SHA-256: `a19015a1a92d52025a2fb6703b6d67eadd1cc2aeaf880770e96e04cf6aa07be1`
- License: MIT, stored at `LICENSE-animejs.md`

Only `animate` and `stagger` are imported by the EAI documentation homepage.

## Primer Octicons

- File: inline SVG symbols in `../../_templates/page.html`
- Version: 19.19.0
